Production Glossary · 39/50 · audio

Loudness target

Definition

Loudness target is the specified integrated loudness and measurement conditions a finished audio program should meet. In a controlled workflow, its owner, version and acceptance evidence should be recorded.

Why it matters

This concept helps production teams align audio decisions, handoffs and verification without relying on unstated assumptions.

Related terms

  • Audio stem
  • True peak
